name: Black Bean Mango Salad
steps: Rinse the cooked black beans and drain thoroughly. Cook sweetcorn in boiling water until tender, then drain and cool.
Cut mango and capsicum into small cubes; finely chop onion, chilli and coriander.
Whisk lime juice, olive oil, cumin and salt in a serving bowl until the salt dissolves.
Add beans, corn and chopped vegetables. Fold in mango and coriander last so the fruit keeps its shape, then serve.
tips: Use cooked canned beans or beans boiled until completely tender; raw beans are not suitable.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
